document-production-orchestrator: Coordinate multi-stage reports, presentations, and combined deliverables. Route narrow edits, exports, or reviews to the needed specialist.
professional-publication: Compose or revise reports, briefs, and manuals with editable sources and inspected pages. Use PDF production for export-only work.
professional-presentation: Develop, build, repair, or export editable presentations. Use narrative mode for new decks and build mode for approved slide specifications.
publication-design-system: Define typography, colour, layout, and component contracts for documents. Preserve templates, extend brands, or establish a reusable system.
content-information-architecture: Plan evidence-led content, fit copy without losing meaning, or audit citations and credits. Select a focused mode for local edits or reference checks.
data-visualisation: Choose and produce charts, maps, or readable tables for evidence-led documents. Use table mode for exact lookup without a chart workflow.
svg-illustration: Create and verify editable SVG diagrams, icons, and timelines, including measured label fit and target rendering. Use data visualisation for charts.
pdf-production: Export and preflight PDFs; check expected properties and transformed-file integrity. Use after composition or for focused PDF inspection.
visual-quality-assurance: Inspect every rendered page, slide, or visual; record defects and verify repairs with current render evidence and schema-validated QA.
image-art-direction: Select, crop, and credit report or presentation imagery. Check placed resolution, focal protection, authenticity, rights, and destination variants.
